motivation: The complete-case island-partition analysis showed a strong ungated within-island covariance signal but failed its predeclared completeness gate because colony identifiers are structurally unbalanced. The phase validation confirmed the signal for 1991-2006 but could not validly evaluate 2007-2017 after extinction and identifier discontinuities. This analysis tests the same ecological proposition without requiring complete colony histories.

data.growth_observation: For an island-specific colony_code, use an annual transition only when both adjacent census years are reported. Retain positive-to-zero and zero-to-positive transitions; exclude zero-to-zero transitions.
data.eligible_colony: At least 3 informative annual transitions and non-zero SD of annual log1p growth.

residualization: For each eligible colony, standardize its informative annual log1p-growth values to mean 0 and SD 1 across its own observed transitions.
For each end year, subtract the mean standardized growth across all eligible colonies observed in that year. This removes the regional year component without using island labels.

primary_statistic.name: island_year_covariance_contrast
primary_statistic.definition: Across all co-observed colony-pair × year products of regional-residualized standardized growth, compute mean product for pairs assigned to the same island minus mean product for pairs assigned to different islands.
primary_statistic.ecological_meaning: Positive values indicate that colonies on the same island share annual deviations beyond colony-specific scale and the regional year effect.

null.strata: Order eligible colonies first by number of informative transitions and break ties by mean log1p abundance; split this deterministic ranked list into 5 equal-count strata. Permute observed island labels within strata, preserving label counts in each stratum.
null.test: two-sided permutation p; support additionally requires observed contrast > 0

analyses.primary: All five islands across all eligible 1991-2017 transitions.
analyses.sensitivity: Repeat after excluding Litchfield Island entirely.
analyses.strong_confirmation: Both primary and four-island sensitivity must have positive contrast and two-sided p <= 0.05.

descriptive_outputs: same-island and between-island mean pair-year products
number of eligible colonies and informative transitions per island
early 1991-2006 and late 2007-2017 contrasts using the same frozen residualization/statistic, descriptive only
interpretation_boundaries: This tests island-level demographic coherence, not coastline effects after geographic distance is controlled.
A positive result does not identify dispersal, habitat, foraging, or observer processes as the mechanism.
The within-island spatial-insurance hypothesis remains unsupported and is not rescued by this analysis.
The analysis is explicitly a post-primary missingness-robust validation prompted by the failed complete-case validity gate.
Do not change the eligibility threshold, residualization, pair-year statistic, stratification rule, permutation count, Litchfield sensitivity, or decision rule after outcomes are opened.
